title: 2019 AMC 8 Problem 11
statement: The eighth grade class at Lincoln Middle School has \(93\) students. Each student takes a math class or a foreign language class or both. There are \(70\) eighth graders taking a math class, and there are \(54\) eighth graders taking a foreign language class. How many eighth graders take only a math class and not a foreign language class?

solutions.text:
The number of kids that are taking both classes is \[ 70 + 54 - 93 = 31. \] Subtracting this from the number of kids taking a math class will give us the number of kids taking only a math class.

The desired number is \(70 - 31 = 39.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: First find how many students are counted twice
Only math = math total minus both classes
